summary: Pre-Phase-3 correction gate (ADR-011) frontend verification. Verified partner shell pivot (QC → Logistics), supplier evidence-first declaration flow, QC persona redirect, terminology cleanup (no 'FloraSetu QC/QC Approved/Submit QC' anywhere in supplier/buyer/partner UI), and regressions for dual & admin personas. Full driver job flow (assigned jobs → accept → pickup → transit → deliver, plus exception flow) was NOT end-to-end exercised because the seed-pilot-order.sh helper requires a legacy testing-agent user (supplier.test8@dev.florasetu.local / Supplier2026x) that is not present in the current preview DB and rebuilding the full requirement→RFQ→quote→award→order chain is out of scope of pure frontend testing. Partner logistics shell, empty states, nav testids, and route redirects all confirmed working.

integration_issues.issue: Login as demo.dual@florasetu.dev redirects straight to /buyer/org instead of the workspace chooser at /. The chooser only shows when the user manually navigates to /. Because a fresh login has no restored context, WorkspaceRouter should render (it does — verified at /), but the login flow’s final navigation lands on a specific workspace home before the router can pick. Minor UX regression; workspace chooser itself is fully functional (testid workspace-chooser with both Buyer + Supplier options for Ooty Floral Trading).

action_items: (Minor) Ensure login redirect for users with multiple permitted workspaces lands on / (WorkspaceRouter) rather than a specific workspace home, so the chooser is shown by default on first login.
critical_code_review_comments: Supplier declaration UX is well-instrumented with data-testids (lot-quality-basis, lot-media-input, lot-video-input, lot-declare-panel, lot-declare-btn, lot-declaration-panel).

lot-media-input is a single-file input (no `multiple` attr) but the UX text implies multiple photos; users must upload them one at a time. Consider adding `multiple` to accept multi-file selection in one dialog for smoother onboarding.
PartnerJobsPage empty states + nav testids (partner-nav-jobs, partner-nav-delivered, partner-jobs-empty) are all present and behave correctly on desktop and mobile (390px).

success_rate.frontend: 11/13 verified PASS, 2 driver-flow scenarios skipped due to seed dependency

test_credentials: Used demo.logistics, demo.qc, demo.supplier, demo.dual, demo.admin from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all valid.
seed_data_creation: Created one supplier harvest lot (Premium/Dutch Rose, 100 BOX, LOT-2026-000001) under Dev Supplier Co via demo.supplier UI. Declared with 2 photos and Batch B-TEST-1 → status AVAILABLE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Driver logistics flow (accept → pickup → transit → deliver) and exception-reporting flow were not executed end-to-end because the seed-pilot-order.sh script depends on supplier.test8@dev.florasetu.local (not present in preview DB after re-seed). To exercise those flows: (1) either recreate that supplier user + password (register via API + attach to a GROWER org), or refactor seed-pilot-order.sh to use demo.supplier@florasetu.dev / Demo-Supplier-2026 (already seeded) as the supplier side. Once a shipment can be assigned to demo.driver, the UI flow at /partner/logistics with partner-jobs-toggle + partner-job-card-* + partner-job-detail + job-accept-btn / job-pickup-nophoto-btn / job-transit-btn / job-deliver-nophoto-btn / job-exception-btn testids is ready to be exercised. Main agent already reported 213/213 backend e2e green including 13 new gate tests, so the backend side of that flow is trusted.
